biography.value: Glacier Giants apply Frozen reliably at Margin 2, which Restrains targets, and then Grapple at Margin 3 to add ongoing cold damage on top of the movement restriction. Glacier Hurl can apply Frozen at range, meaning they can immobilize high-priority targets before closing. The Frost Aura's Numbed condition on everything within 10 feet means enemies fighting in melee are taking stacking cold conditions from proximity alone. A summoner who keeps one engaged consistently will find the battlefield progressively frozen — literally — within a few rounds.

system.attacksNotes:
Permafrost Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 damage (5 + 6 Str) + 3 cold damage (Half DR); target gains Frosted condition.
  • Margin 2: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 cold damage; target gains Frozen condition + Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 cold damage + Frozen + Prone; target Grappled as ice encases their limbs; ongoing 8 cold damage per round while Grappled.

Glacier Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 4), Range: 80/160 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 cold damage (9 + 5 Dex); target gains Frosted + movement halved.
  • Margin 2: 14 cold damage, DR halved (round up); target gains Frozen + Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 14 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + Prone; target Restrained by ice impact for 1 round; Fortitude save (1 success) to move.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Frost Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 10 feet take 6 cold damage (Half DR) and gain the Numbed condition. Powerful Build: Glacier Giant counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Ice Stride: Moves across ice and snow at full speed. Creates a thin frost trail wherever it walks; surfaces within 5 feet of its path become Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. Permafrost: Ground within 20 feet of the Glacier Giant where it has stood for at least 1 round becomes frozen. Frozen ground is Difficult Terrain and creatures moving across it make Acrobatics [Easy] checks or fall Prone. Resilient Defense (1/day): When the Glacier Giant fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
